clusters.headline: DMK And NCP-SP Split On Government's New Delimitation Bill
aiSummaryBullets: The DMK and the NCP (SP) faction have announced support for the Centre's revised Delimitation Bill, departing from the broader INDIA alliance's stance.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated the legislation fulfills commitments to Nari Shakti, while the government emphasized updated provisions including a 2051 population freeze.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Rejects Plea To Lower Minimum Election Contest Age
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court bench declined to entertain a petition requesting a lower minimum age for election candidates.
Legal counsel for the petitioner requested that authorities address the status of a prior representation regarding the matter.

clusters.headline: FSSAI Prosecutes Bisleri Over New Coliform Bacteria Findings
aiSummaryBullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has initiated prosecution against Bisleri after detecting coliform bacteria in samples.
Bisleri maintains that the specific West Bengal batch was recalled in August and states independent labs found the water met safety standards.

clusters.headline: Tensions Rise Between MK Stalin and TVK Following VS Babu's Death
aiSummaryBullets: Political friction between MK Stalin's DMK and Vijay's TVK has intensified following the death of MLA VS Babu.
The parties are currently in a public dispute over the proposed Delimitation Bill and the handling of the Deepam row.

clusters.headline: Centre Proposes Expanding Lok Sabha Seats To 815 By Year 2051
aiSummaryBullets: The government has introduced a proposal to increase the total number of Lok Sabha seats from 543 to 815 by the year 2051.
The new plan includes a measure to freeze the proportion of seats allocated to each individual state until the 2051 deadline.

clusters.headline: Bombay High Court Rules Son Must Return Gifted Flat To Father
aiSummaryBullets: An 88-year-old man sought legal recourse after moving into an old-age home.
The Bombay High Court ruled that a flat previously gifted to the son must be returned.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting In Tamil Nadu
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court issued contempt notices to Tamil Nadu officials regarding the failure to facilitate the lighting of a lamp on Tirupparankundram Hill.
Central Reserve Police Force personnel have been directed to oversee the Karthigai Deepam lighting ceremony to ensure compliance with court orders.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting In Thiruparankundram
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court mandated the lighting of a ceremonial lamp at the Deepathoon stone pillar in Madurai, following past non-compliance issues.
CRPF personnel have been deployed to secure the site, while state officials and the temple trust face contempt notices from the court.

clusters.headline: Yogi Adityanath Addresses Political Criticism Following Family Loss
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attended his mother's final rites in Haridwar following her passing at age 91.
The Chief Minister has engaged in verbal exchanges with political rivals, including criticism directed at the Samajwadi Party.

clusters.headline: Nandini Curd Price Reduced In Karnataka Following Public Backlash
aiSummaryBullets: The retail price for Nandini curd has been lowered by Rs 2 per kilogram.
The adjustment follows reports of public dissatisfaction regarding earlier cost increases.

clusters.headline: Amritpal Singh, Breakaway Akali Groups And BJP Negotiate Alliance
aiSummaryBullets: Amritpal Singh is reportedly planning to contest Punjab assembly seats while negotiating a regional alliance.
The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal have formed a renewed partnership to compete in the upcoming 2027 state elections.

clusters.headline: West Bengal Cabinet Approves State Renaming To Paschim Banga
aiSummaryBullets: The West Bengal cabinet officially approved the proposal to rename the state to Paschim Banga in both Hindi and English.
Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari is scheduled to introduce the formal motion for this renaming process in the legislative assembly on December 9.

clusters.headline: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Concludes First Official India Visit To Delhi
aiSummaryBullets: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah held his first official bilateral visit to India, meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi.
India committed to providing $1.6 billion in financial assistance to Nepal to support infrastructure, energy, and technology projects.

clusters.headline: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh Arrested Over Harassment Complaint
aiSummaryBullets: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh was arrested by police following a harassment complaint filed by a woman IAS officer.
The case involves charges under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

clusters.headline: Three Arrested After Woman Allegedly Gang-Raped at Preet Vihar Cafe
aiSummaryBullets: Three suspects have been taken into custody by police following a reported sexual assault at a cafe in Preet Vihar.
The group of arrested individuals includes two women and one man, according to law enforcement reporting.

clusters.headline: Regional Authorities Expand Ethanol Fuel Testing Following Concerns
aiSummaryBullets: Keralam authorities have begun collecting petrol samples from various fuel stations to verify ethanol content following reports from Karnataka.
Karnataka officials conducted tests at 67 locations after finding ethanol levels reaching up to 31% in samples, exceeding the mandated E20 blend.

clusters.headline: Indian Nationals Among Fourteen Killed In UAE Multi-Vehicle Crash
aiSummaryBullets: A multi-vehicle traffic collision in Fujairah, United Arab Emirates, resulted in fourteen fatalities.
Among the deceased are multiple individuals originating from Malappuram, India.

clusters.headline: India-Pakistan U19 Cricket Match Controversy Over Neutrality
aiSummaryBullets: Observers raised concerns regarding umpire conduct during the India-Pakistan match following a celebratory gesture toward the Pakistani side.
The Indian cricket team faced criticism for opting to boycott the customary post-match handshake with the Pakistani players.

clusters.headline: Political Clash Intensifies Across India On Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP and Congress engaged in mutual accusations of undermining constitutional values during commemorations.
Union Minister Amit Shah criticized Congress leadership regarding the status of the Women's Reservation Bill.

clusters.headline: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik Joins SCO Forum Amid Delhi Tensions
aiSummaryBullets: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik attended the SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi, sparking political debate in India.
The forum concluded with the adoption of an outcome document highlighting the role of shared history and cultural exchange among SCO members.
